40022589.author: पदार्थः
40022589.content: सः he, मुहूर्तात् after a short while, उपश्रुत्य having heard, देवर्षिः the divine sage, अमितप्रभः of immeasurable splendor, स्वम् his own, आश्रमम् hermitage, शिष्यवृतः surrounded by disciples, क्षुधार्तः afflicted by hunger, सन्न्यवर्तत he returned.

40022589.author: Translation
40022589.content: After a short while, the divine sage of immeasurable splendor, surrounded by his disciples and afflicted by hunger, returned to his hermitage, having heard (something amiss).

40022590.author: पदार्थः
40022590.content: सः he, अपश्यत् he saw, अरजाम् Arajā, दीनाम् distressed, रजसा with impurity, समभिप्लुताम् covered, ज्योत्स्नाम् moonlight, इव like, ग्रहग्रस्ताम् eclipsed, प्रत्यूषे at dawn, न not, विराजतीम् shining.

40022590.author: Translation
40022590.content: He saw Arajā, distressed and covered with impurity, like moonlight eclipsed by a planet and not shining brightly at dawn.

40022591.author: पदार्थः
40022591.content: तस्य his, रोषः anger, समभवत् arose, क्षुधार्तस्य of the hungry one, विशेषतः especially, निर्दहन्निव as if burning, लोकान् worlds, त्रीन् three, शिष्यान् to the disciples, च and, एतत् this, उवाच said, ह indeed.

40022591.author: Translation
40022591.content: His anger, especially due to hunger, arose as if burning the three worlds, and he spoke this to his disciples.

40022592.author: पदार्थः
40022592.content: पश्यध्वं behold, विपरीतस्य of the perverse, दण्डस्य of Daṇḍa, अविजितात्मनः of the uncontrolled one, विपत्तिं the calamity, घोरसङ्काशां terrible-looking, क्रुद्धां enraged, अग्निशिखाम् a flame of fire, इव like.

40022592.author: Translation
40022592.content: Behold the terrible calamity, like an enraged flame of fire, that will befall the perverse and uncontrolled King Daṇḍa.

40022593.author: पदार्थः
40022593.content: क्षयः destruction, अस्य of this, दुर्मतेः evil-minded one, प्राप्तः is imminent, सानुगस्य with his followers, दुरात्मनः of the wicked one, यः who, प्रदीप्तां blazing, हुताशस्य of fire, शिखां a flame, वै indeed, स्प्रष्टुम् to touch, इच्छति desires.

40022593.author: Translation
40022593.content: The destruction of this evil-minded and wicked one, along with his followers, is imminent, for he desires to touch a blazing flame of fire.

40022594.author: पदार्थः
40022594.content: यस्मात् because, सः he, कृतवान् has committed, पापम् a sin, ईदृशं such, घोरसंहितम् a terrible one, तस्मात् therefore, प्राप्स्यति will obtain, दुर्मेधाः the foolish one, फलं the fruit, पापस्य of the evil, कर्मणः deed.

40022594.author: Translation
40022594.content: Because he has committed such a terrible sin, that foolish one will therefore receive the consequence of his evil deed.

40022595.author: पदार्थः
40022595.content: सप्तरात्रेण within seven nights, राजा king, असौ that, सभृत्यबलवाहनः with his servants, army, and vehicles, पापकर्मसमाचारः whose conduct is sinful, वधं death, प्राप्स्यति will meet, दुर्मतिः the evil-minded one.

40022595.author: Translation
40022595.content: Within seven nights, that evil-minded king, whose conduct is sinful, will meet his death along with his servants, army, and vehicles.

40022596.author: पदार्थः
40022596.content: समन्तात् all around, योजनशतम् a hundred yojanas, विषयम् the region, च and, अस्य of this, दुर्मतेः evil-minded one, धक्ष्यते will burn, पांसुवर्षेण by a dust shower, महता great, पाकशासनः Paka-shasana (Indra).

40022596.author: Translation
40022596.content: Shukra declares that Indra will destroy the evil-minded Daṇḍa's region, extending a hundred yojanas in all directions, with a mighty shower of dust.

40022597.author: पदार्थः
40022597.content: सर्वसत्वानि all beings, यानि which, इह here, स्थावराणि immobile, चराणि mobile, च and, महता by a great, पांसुवर्षेण dust shower, विलयम् destruction, सर्वतः completely, अगमन् reached.

40022597.author: Translation
40022597.content: All beings, both mobile and immobile, present in that region, completely met their destruction due to the great shower of dust.

40022598.author: पदार्थः
40022598.content: दण्डस्य of Daṇḍa, विषयः the region, यावत् as far as, तावत् so far, सर्वसमुच्छ्रयम् all elevated things, पांसुवर्षम् a dust shower, इव like, अलक्ष्यम् imperceptible, सप्तरात्रम् for seven nights, भविष्यति will be.

40022598.author: Translation
40022598.content: For seven nights, the entire region of Daṇḍa, including all elevated structures, will become imperceptible, as if covered by a continuous shower of dust.

40022599.author: पदार्थः
40022599.content: इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, क्रोधताम्राक्षः with eyes red with anger, तदाश्रमनिवासिनम् to the residents of that hermitage, जनम् the people, जनपदान्तेषु at the borders of the country, स्थीयताम् let it be stayed, इति thus, च and, अब्रवीत् he said.

40022599.author: Translation
40022599.content: Having spoken thus, Shukra, whose eyes were red with anger, instructed the people residing in that hermitage to stay at the borders of the country.

40022600.author: पदार्थः
40022600.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु indeed, उशनसः of Ushanas, वाक्यम् the word, सः that, आश्रमावसथः hermitage-dwelling, जनः people, निष्क्रान्तः departed, विषयात् from the region, तस्मात् from that, स्थानम् place, चक्रे made, अथ then, बाह्यतः outside.

40022600.author: Translation
40022600.content: Having heard the words of Ushanas (Shukra), the people dwelling in that hermitage then departed from that region and established their abode outside.

40022601.author: पदार्थः
40022601.content: सः He, तथा thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, मुनिजनम् to the sages, अरजाम् to Araja, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said, इह एव here itself, वस dwell, दुर्मेधे O foolish one, आश्रमे in the hermitage, सुसमाहिता well-composed.

40022601.author: Translation
40022601.content: Having thus spoken to the sages, he then said to Araja, "O foolish one, dwell here in this hermitage, well-composed."

40022602.author: पदार्थः
40022602.content: इदम् This, योजनपर्यन्तम् extending for a yojana, सरः lake, सुरुचिरप्रभम् of very beautiful splendor, अरजे O Araja, विज्वरा free from distress, भुङ्क्ष्व enjoy, कालः च and time, अत्र here, प्रतीक्ष्यताम् let it be awaited.

40022602.author: Translation
40022602.content: O Araja, enjoy this lake, which extends for a yojana and possesses a very beautiful splendor, free from distress, and let time pass here.

40022603.author: पदार्थः
40022603.content: त्वत्समीपे near you, च and, ये those, सत्त्वाः beings, वासम् dwelling, एष्यन्ति will come, ताम् that, निशाम् night, अवध्याः invulnerable, पांसुवर्षेण by the shower of dust, ते they, भविष्यन्ति will be, नित्यदा always.

40022603.author: Translation
40022603.content: And those beings who come to dwell near you for that night will always be invulnerable to the shower of dust.

40022604.author: पदार्थः
40022604.content: श्रुत्वा Having heard, नियोगम् the command, ब्रह्मर्षेः of the Brahmarshi, सा she, अरजा Araja, भार्गवी the daughter of Bhargava, तदा then, तथा इति "So be it", पितरम् to her father, प्राह said, भार्गवम् to Bhargava, भृशदुःखिता greatly distressed; इति उक्त्वा having said this, भार्गवः Bhargava, वासम् dwelling, अन्यत्र elsewhere, समकारयत् caused to be made.

40022604.author: Translation
40022604.content: Greatly distressed, Araja, the daughter of Bhargava, then said "So be it" to her father, the Brahmarshi, after hearing his command; having said this, Bhargava then arranged for his dwelling elsewhere.

40022605.author: पदार्थः
40022605.content: तत् च And that, राज्यम् kingdom, नरेन्द्रस्य of the king, सभृत्यबलवाहनम् with servants, army, and vehicles, सप्ताहात् within seven days, भस्मसाद्भूतम् turned into ashes, यथा उक्तम् as spoken, ब्रह्मवादिना by the speaker of Brahman.

40022605.author: Translation
40022605.content: And that kingdom of the king, along with its servants, army, and vehicles, was reduced to ashes within seven days, just as the sage had foretold.

40022606.author: पदार्थः
40022606.content: तस्य his, असौ this, दण्डविषयः region of Daṇḍa, विन्ध्यशैवलयोः of Vindhya and Śaivala, नृप O king, शप्तः cursed, ब्रह्मर्षिणा by the Brahmarṣi, तेन by him, वैधर्म्ये unrighteousness, सहिते accompanied, कृते having been done.

40022606.author: Translation
40022606.content: O king, this region of Daṇḍa, situated between the Vindhya and Śaivala mountains, was cursed by that Brahmarṣi when unrighteousness was committed there.

40022607.author: पदार्थः
40022607.content: ततः from then, प्रभृति onwards, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, दण्डकारण्यम् Daṇḍaka forest, उच्यते is called, तपस्विनः ascetics, स्थिताः resided, हि indeed, अत्र here, जनस्थानम् Janasthāna, अतः therefore, अभवत् became.

40022607.author: Translation
40022607.content: O Kakutstha, from that time onwards, this region is called Daṇḍakāraṇya, and because ascetics resided here, it also became known as Janasthāna.

40022608.author: पदार्थः
40022608.content: एतत् this, ते to you, सर्वम् all, आख्यातम् has been told, यत् which, माम् me, पृच्छसि you ask, राघव O Raghava, सन्ध्याम् twilight prayer, उपासितुम् to perform, वीर O hero, समयः time, हि indeed, अतिवर्तते is passing.

40022608.author: Translation
40022608.content: O Raghava, I have told you all that you asked me, but O hero, the time for performing the twilight prayer is indeed passing.

40022609.author: पदार्थः
40022609.content: एते these, महर्षयः great sages, सर्वे all, पूर्णकुम्भाः with full water pots, समन्ततः all around, कृतोदकाः having performed water rituals, नरव्याघ्र O tiger among men, आदित्यम् the sun god, पर्युपासते are worshipping.

40022609.author: Translation
40022609.content: O tiger among men, all these great sages, with their water pots full and having performed their water rituals, are worshipping the sun god all around.

40022610.author: पदार्थः
40022610.content: सः he, तैः by them, ब्राह्मणम् the Brahman, अभ्यस्तम् practiced, सहितैः together with, ब्रह्मवित्तमैः by the best knowers of Brahman, रविः the sun, अस्तम् setting, गतः has gone, राम O Rama, गच्छ go, उदकम् water, उपस्पृश touch.

40022610.author: Translation
40022610.content: O Rama, the sun has set, having been worshipped by those best knowers of Brahman who recite the Vedas; therefore, go and perform your ablutions. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकाशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 81 ।। Thus ends the eighty-first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
